defect: Permission hardening opened and closed duplicate descriptors for files owned by a live SQLite connection, cancelling process-wide POSIX locks.
failureScenario: Two Braid processes open the same WAL database and call secureArtifacts -> one process loses its SQLite lock and faults on the shared-memory mapping with SIGBUS.
evidence: test/effect-admission.test.ts:24-69; pre-fix repeated two-process command -> 1 of 9 attempts exited SIGBUS; strace located the fault inside braid.sqlite-shm
fix: Use lstat, chmod, and inode/owner/mode rechecks without opening another descriptor.
verification: pnpm test:coordination -> 27 of 27 pass; five additional repetitions -> 60 of 60 process pairs pass; pnpm check -> 494 pass, 0 fail, 2 credential skips
costIfShipped: 1 crash per 9 observed two-process attempts, assuming the observed Linux rate represents affected launches

defect: The new README linked a GIF that Git ignored, so the hero media would disappear from a clean checkout.
failureScenario: A reader opens README.md on GitHub after merge -> artifacts/verification/w6/braid.gif is absent and the first product visual is broken.
fix: Track the generated GIF and replayable terminal cast explicitly.
verification: git ls-files --stage artifacts/verification/w6/braid.gif artifacts/verification/w6/raw/braid-demo.cast -> 2 of 2 files tracked

defect: Terminal run events finalized the message but left active reasoning and tool parts in running state and collapsed distinct terminal outcomes.
failureScenario: Any completed, failed, aborted, cancelled, blocked, expired, or unknown run has an active detail part -> the transcript keeps a spinner or reports the wrong terminal state.
fix: Map every run outcome to a part outcome and close every running part on both normalized and legacy finalization paths.
verification: test/domain-reducer.test.ts terminal outcome table -> 7 of 7 pass; pnpm check -> 494 pass, 0 fail

defect: Slash-command completion captured capability descriptions once at startup even though capabilities change after a run.
failureScenario: A completed run enables /ask -> autocomplete still labels /ask unavailable and steers the user away from a working command.
fix: Rebuild the Pi completion provider only when the current command list changes, retaining the stale-input guard.
verification: test/w6-ui.test.ts:482-495 -> 1 of 1 transition passes; artifacts/verification/w6/braid.gif shows /ask accepted after completion
costIfShipped: 1 stale command per 1 tested capability transition
savedIfFixed: 1 correct command per 1 tested capability transition

defect: The visual fixture flag was accepted without the deterministic provider flag.
failureScenario: A user starts Braid with --ui-fixture product-demo alone -> synthetic profile and analysis state can enter a non-fixture session.
evidence: a34c7ff:src/bin/args.ts:147 accepted uiFixture independently; test/cli-startup.test.ts:42-52 covers rejection and valid pairing
fix: Reject every --ui-fixture invocation unless --fixture deterministic is also present.
verification: test/cli-startup.test.ts:42-52 -> 2 of 2 parser cases pass; pnpm check -> 494 pass, 0 fail
costIfShipped: 1 unsafe invocation per 1 tested unpaired flag
savedIfFixed: 1 rejected unsafe invocation per 1 tested unpaired flag

defect: An early candidate treated disappearance after the first identity check as optional absence instead of a failed identity check.
failureScenario: A WAL or shared-memory file disappears between initial lstat and chmod or final lstat -> permission hardening reports success instead of failing closed.
evidence: src/adapters/storage/sqlite-paths.ts:172-223 separates initial ENOENT from every error after inspection
fix: Allow absence only on the first lstat and wrap every later filesystem error as STORAGE_PERMISSIONS.
verification: static branch inspection at src/adapters/storage/sqlite-paths.ts:172-223; pnpm check -> 494 pass, 0 fail
costIfShipped: unmeasured filesystem races per run because replacement frequency is unavailable
savedIfFixed: unmeasured filesystem races rejected per run for the same unavailable frequency
